## Per-chapter highlights

### Chapter 1 — The Burnt Offering (Olah)

*status:* draft
*themes:* covenant, messianic-prophecy, restoration

Leviticus opens with the LORD calling Moses from the Tabernacle just completed at the close of Exodus, and gives the first of five offering- types: the burnt offering (olah, "ascending"). A male without blemish from the herd, flock, or fowl, voluntarily offered, with the offerer's hand laid on its head; the whole animal consumed on the altar as "a sweet savour unto the LORD." The chapter establishes the foundational pattern — substitutionary atonement and total devotion to God — that the rest of the sacrificial system builds on.
